_comment: Golden set = spec §8. Reference facts were written before the build (tag v2-clock-start) from data/customers.json and the indexed Getnet pages, so the judge is not tuned to the output. `expect` is checked deterministically on the LAST turn; the judge scores the last answer against `reference_facts` and the turn evidence. Added after the build (declared in docs/timesheet.md): case R1 (replanning), handoff=false on the live-data cases 2 and 7, and the no_spurious_rewrite check on every single-turn case.
